summary: Build a new marketing website for a sofa cleaning service (Magical Service / Magical Sofa Cleaning) targeting Ahmedabad & Gandhinagar, with English + Gujarati mixed user-facing content.
architectural_notes: Content language requirement changed to English + Gujarati mix (bilingual/mixed copy) across the site.
Services scope update: remove Home Cleaning; offer Sofa, Carpet, Chair, Mattress cleaning + AC Water Jet service.
Explicit scope constraint: no AI features should be added (now or future).
User requested adding AI-based future features, which conflicts with the existing explicit scope constraint of no AI features.
User-provided UI snippet introduces an on-page 'AI assistant' chat widget and a pay-by-QR section (Google Pay) toggled by chat keywords.
User-provided snippet hides an older/larger QR image via CSS selectors and replaces it with a smaller QR inside the chat widget.
Snippet references an externally hosted QR image URL (caffeine.xyz) for the payment QR.
Areas Served UI change requested: group locations under separate Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar headings and make the list more compact.
QR code display requirement updated: show QR in a smaller/compact size.
Add social link support: include an Instagram icon that links to the Magical Sofa Cleaning Instagram profile.
known_issues: Potential conflict: existing scope requires all user-facing text in English, but latest requirement is English + Gujarati mix.
Scope conflict: user asked to add AI-based future features, but project scope explicitly forbids AI features.
Scope conflict risk: user-provided 'AI assistant' chat widget contradicts the explicit project constraint of no AI features anywhere on the website.
Potential asset policy conflict: chat widget uses an externally hosted QR image URL (caffeine.xyz), which may conflict with the 'no external imagery' approach used elsewhere.
Scope conflict risk: existing requirement is mixed English+Gujarati copy, but user now requests converting content to English-only.
Expectation risk: user wants the site to rank #1 across all Ahmedabad; SEO improvements can be made but top ranking cannot be guaranteed.
Potential palette constraint conflict: existing direction avoids blue/purple as primary, but user requested using blue (along with yellow/orange).

Potential compliance/credibility risk: adding '210+ reviews and comments' must reflect real Google reviews; avoid fabricated testimonials and ensure proper attribution/permissions if embedding/displaying.
User indicates the hero/before-after image was changed; needs to be reverted to the previously used photo.
Asset dependency: “live photos” (real service photos) are requested but not yet provided; needs image assets and confirmation of usage rights.

existing_features.title: Create a new single-page marketing website for a sofa cleaning service, based on the provided HTML content structure (Hero, Services, Contact CTAs, Footer), implemented in the existing React + Tailwind app.

Create a coherent, premium “cleaning service” visual theme and apply it consistently (colors, typography, spacing, buttons, cards). Do not use a blue/purple primary palette.

Do not add any AI-based features (now or as placeholder “future” functionality) anywhere in the website.
